item.title: The road to Te Matatini 2027: Your ultimate guide to the regional competitions
item.description: From Rotorua heavyweights to Gold Coast hopefuls, 11 regional competitions over the coming months will decide who earns a place on the biggest kapa haka stage in Waikato next year. We’re officially on the road to Te Matatini 2027. There will be 11 regional kapa haka competitions across Aotearoa and one in Australia over the next four months. The top groups from each competition will qualify for the next national Te Matatini, to be held at Hopuhopu in Waikato from February 22 to February 27, 2027

item.description: It’s the second time the party has scrapped one of its flagship members’ bills to make way for a new one.
